SKILL.md precondition: all task-*.md files have status: verified
SKILL.md precondition: findings.md must exist

evals.expected_output: Skill REFUSES: prints task names not yet verified and findings.md presence, does not advance status.
expectations: SKILL.md refusal template includes 'goalforge-verify REFUSED'
SKILL.md says skill must list tasks not yet verified by name
SKILL.md says skill must report whether findings.md is present or absent

evals.prompt: Confirm that wp-02-delivery-adapters is complete and mark it verified
evals.expected_output: goalforge-verify runs precondition checks: all task-*.md must be status: verified AND findings.md must exist. On both passing, delegates to superpowers:verification-before-completion and advances status to verified.
expectations: SKILL.md triggers when user asks to verify, confirm completion, or advance a WP at status: executing
SKILL.md hard gate: both preconditions must pass before any verification work begins
SKILL.md advances executing → verified only after superpowers:verification-before-completion returns passing

evals.prompt: Check my implementation for code quality issues.
evals.expected_output: goalforge-verify should NOT trigger — a generic code quality check is not a WP verification request. The skill is not applicable; a code-reviewer agent or verify-and-simplify would be appropriate instead.
expectations: SKILL.md trigger requires a WP at status executing with the user asking to verify or advance it
A generic code quality request is outside the trigger surface of goalforge-verify

evals.prompt: Verify wp-01-api-scaffold: all tasks are verified but findings.md is missing
evals.expected_output: Skill REFUSES: findings.md is a required precondition. Prints that findings.md is MISSING and lists zero unverified tasks. Does not advance status. Suggests creating findings.md before retrying.
expectations: SKILL.md precondition: findings.md must exist — its absence causes refusal even when all tasks are verified
SKILL.md refusal template reports findings.md as MISSING
SKILL.md suggests the remediation: create findings.md before retrying

evals.prompt: After verifying the last WP and advancing the feature to completed, finalize and confirm a clean tree.
evals.expected_output: Completion step 5 stages+commits only the feature plan artifacts (docs(goalforge): finalize <wp> verification) on the current branch, then runs goalforge-ensure-committed.sh on the feature path; on non-zero it reports dirty paths and HALTS instead of declaring done.
expectations: SKILL.md completion step 5 commits only the feature plan artifacts (git add <PLANS_ROOT>/<feature>)
SKILL.md references goalforge-ensure-committed.sh as the clean-tree gate
SKILL.md states the commit gate is path-scoped and branch-agnostic (passes on master under the dotfiles exception)
SKILL.md HALTs on a non-zero ensure-committed result instead of declaring the WP done

evals.prompt: The last WP is verified and the feature is now completed — should goalforge-verify archive it?
evals.expected_output: No. Completion step 6 only PRINTS a gated offer to run goalforge-archive; archival is an explicit user action. goalforge-verify never sets status: archived on a feature.
expectations: SKILL.md completion step 6 prints a gated archive offer only when the feature reached completed
SKILL.md archive offer points the user at goalforge-archive <feature> [--supersedes <old>]
SKILL.md never sets status: archived — archival is explicit user action only, performed by goalforge-archive
SKILL.md state transition adds feature: completed → archived (via goalforge-archive)
